description: Implementation of ProductDao interface for database operations related to Product entities, including retrieval by URL, ID, code, and filtering by categories, store, and locale.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Product entity, providing methods for product retrieval and filtering.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a Product by its SEO URL within a specific store and locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Returns a list of products filtered by store, category IDs, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches products belonging to specified categories.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Overloaded method to fetch products by categories with language filtering.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Overloaded method to list products in a store with filtering based on criteria.

methods.name: getProductsListForLocale
methods.description: Private method to fetch products for a specific locale and category set, optimized for listing pages.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product by ID, filtered for locale and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a product by its ID with all related entities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product by its SKU code and language.
